snippet.title: Gothic Classic | Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Gothic Classic trilogy is coming to PlayStation and Xbox in 2026!

For the first time, Gothic 1, 2, and 3 will be available on consoles – with updated controls and full gamepad support. Whether you're revisiting the Colony or discovering Myrtana for the first time – it's the perfect time to (re)experience the world of Gothic.

Experience these cult classics on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One in 2026!
